cards.front: How many ḥadīth does رِيَاض الصَّالِحِين contain?
How does each section of رِيَاض الصَّالِحِين open?
cards.back: With a few āyāt, before the ḥadīth

cards.front: What subject matter do the ḥadīth of رِيَاض الصَّالِحِين cover?
What is the ruling on repentance (<bdi>تَوْبَة</bdi>)?
cards.source: Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn — Chapter of Repentance, class notes
Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn — Chapter of Repentance, class notes

cards.text: The conditions of <bdi>تَوْبَة</bdi> for a sin between a person and Allah: {{c1::stopping the sin}}; {{c2::feeling regret}}; {{c3::resolving not to return to it}}
cards.source: Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn — Chapter of Repentance, class notes

cards.front: What happens to <bdi>تَوْبَة</bdi> if one of its conditions is missing?
cards.source: Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn — Chapter of Repentance, class notes

cards.front: What further condition does <bdi>تَوْبَة</bdi> carry when the sin involves another person's right?
cards.back: Restoring that right to them — returning wealth, for example
cards.source: Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn — Chapter of Repentance, class notes

cards.front: When the sin involves a <bdi>حَدّ</bdi> (ḥadd) owed to someone, how is their right restored?
cards.back: By allowing the ḥadd to be carried out, or by seeking their pardon
cards.source: Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn — Chapter of Repentance, class notes
